purpose: Original synthetic fixtures for cross-domain validation of the scene truth model. No external paper text, artwork, figure metadata, or bibliographic record is included.

cases.title: Transmissive optical modulation stack
cases.scenario: A source, one transmissive modulation layer, and a detector form a directed optical path.

cases.title: Multiscale integrated compute assembly
cases.scenario: A device contains a compute core and a representative microstructure shown as linked detail views.

cases.title: Logical compute and memory pipeline
cases.scenario: Functional compute stages exchange logical data without implying literal physical cables.

cases.title: Conformal wearable sensing stack
cases.scenario: A layered wearable sensor contacts anatomy through an explicitly classified interface.

cases.title: Wearable sensor with wireless telemetry
cases.scenario: A wearable sensing module transfers data to a receiver through a field relationship.

cases.title: Wireless implant and external transmitter
cases.scenario: An external transmitter couples to an implant across tissue and the implant contacts a target interface.

cases.title: Aerial robot with a process tool
cases.scenario: A mobile aerial platform carries a tool and operates within a visible work envelope.

cases.title: Ground robot serving laboratory stations
cases.scenario: A mobile manipulator travels between stations and reaches equipment within a declared envelope.

cases.title: Automated laboratory process sequence
cases.scenario: A scheduler coordinates dosing, transfer, processing, and measurement as ordered hardware states.

cases.title: Driven open thermal-fluid process
cases.scenario: A driven open route passes through capture, heating, condensation, and outlet stages.

cases.title: Deformable structure with a sensor skin
cases.scenario: A conformal sensor layer follows a deformable body and reports its state to a processor.

cases.title: Reconfigurable mechanical lattice
cases.scenario: An actuator excites a lattice with multiple declared mechanical states and a deformation envelope.

cases.title: Closed microfluidic perfusion loop
cases.scenario: A pump, chip, and reservoir form a continuous driven loop with a linked channel detail.

cases.title: Closed-loop wearable and implant controller
cases.scenario: A wearable controller and implant exchange wireless commands and feedback while contacting anatomy.
